chapter: Reel 2: Los Angeles musicians, the Apex and Cotton Club
title: The two locations of the Apex on Central Avenue
summary: Mrs. Howard explains the Apex moved from 43rd to 55th Street, around 1935, and that she sang there.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Mrs. Howard and I were whispering back here a few minutes ago, and she told me something that I had never heard before. That was that there were two different locations on Central Avenue for the Apex. And it was first, she said, on the block there on 43rd, right? And then you said it moved to 55th?
Tell us about that. Do you remember the years?
just looking at it. Oh, yeah?
Do you remember anything about the Apex?
Sure we do. She was there, singing in it.
Well she would know, right? Were you playing there, too?
No. I was always trying to get something better?
